hints.title: Digit Pairs Symmetry
hints.text: A palindrome requires symmetric pairs on both wings and at most one middle digit.

hints.title: Leading Zero Prohibition
hints.text: Digit '0' pairs can only be added to the wings if a larger nonzero digit pair has already established the wings.

hints.title: Middle Digit Selection
hints.text: The middle character should be the largest digit with an odd remaining frequency count.

hints.title: Greedy Palindrome Construction Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency counting followed by 10-step greedy string build.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all palindromic permutations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counter and result string take linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles leading zero suppression and largest odd center digit correctly.
